prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a rear-end collision. The patient had 28 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1097; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with neck pain, stiffness, and headache consistent with cervical whiplash. Over the course of 28 visits, care consisted of physical therapy, range-of-motion exercises, manual therapy, and home exercise instruction. Treatment followed a typical clinical course, with visit frequency tapering as symptoms improved and range of motion returned toward baseline. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm soft-tissue injury to the cervical spine. The patient reports no prior injury to the neck or upper back, and none is documented in available records. Whether the current presentation is entirely attributable to this collision remains unclear and will require further review of the causation history. Billing records reflect single charges for each service with no repeated or duplicate entries. Patient was discharged from active care with a home program and instructions to return if symptoms recur.
